run_cheetah_environment: run the dm_control cheetah run task to create a MuJoCo running cheetah environment
get_model_and_assets: get the cheetah MuJoCo model XML string and asset dictionary for loading
physics_speed: get the horizontal speed of the cheetah from the Physics simulation object
cheetah_get_observation: get an observation dict with position and velocity from the cheetah physics state
cheetah_get_reward: get the running reward for the cheetah agent based on its current speed
